question: Should frozen release targets that predate `check:script-declarations` skip only that guard while current targets remain fail-closed, and should the locale refresh land with this PR instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110362?
rationale: This is a deliberate release-validation compatibility policy and consolidation choice; source-level review cannot determine the intended support boundary without release-workflow owner intent.

options.title: Confirm narrow exception
options.body: Accept the historical-only skip after a redacted successful frozen-target run proves validation continues into product checks, and choose one canonical locale-refresh landing PR.

options.title: Backport the guard contract
options.body: Require frozen release targets to provide the declaration-check script instead of adding a historical exception.

options.title: Split the refresh
options.body: Land or close the generated locale-refresh PR separately and keep this PR focused solely on release-workflow compatibility.

recommendation.title: Confirm narrow exception
recommendation.body: Accept the historical-only skip after a redacted successful frozen-target run proves validation continues into product checks, and choose one canonical locale-refresh landing PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR history identifies steipete as the author of the release-workflow change and the person who assigned the review.
